## Repository checks

- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] `make infra-test` passes when infrastructure behavior changes.
- [ ] Live Jev smoke is run only when authorized and applicable.
- [ ] Changes stay within the task scope and architecture boundaries.
- [ ] No secrets, local environments or generated dependencies are included.
- [ ] Required lockfiles and version pins are included when dependencies change.
- [ ] Documentation describes the implemented behavior.
